items.desc_now: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that turns your self-hosted Jira issues into a priority-ordered card board. Each card copies its key, opens the issue, or starts a new Harness session that sends "Please handle <KEY>". Credentials stay on the host.

Eleven open-source plugins for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): offline voice input and speech output, GitHub panel, session archive + PDCA, skills/agents audits, mind map, context library, task ledger, novel pipeline. Bilingual EN/中文.

items.desc_now: 在 DSH 里和 AI 对话时，随手把一句话、一个念头、一张图留下来。先记住，不必先起标题、选分类。

items.desc_now: 给 AI 一张工作图，给你一张检查图。DeepSeek Harness 可执行蓝图：按子图组织项目，按单元查看依赖、修改和测试。

items.desc_now: Edit ask_user_question option cards in place — 编辑选项、修改选项、自定义选项；选中接近的选项后就地调整名称与细节，保留原选项并回传修改说明。
